subject: Personnel Controls: verification bundle and leaver playbook request
messages:
From: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@acme-corp.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: soc2@secureassess.com
Date: 2026-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: personnel verification items for SOC 2 window

Hi Vanessa,

SecureAssess is scheduling our SOC 2 fieldwork for ACME's vendor review the week of Jan 11. To prepare, we need a compact personnel controls package covering hires and leavers for the past 12 months. Can you confirm availability and share the following by Dec 24 if possible?

- Training completion matrix for security, acceptable use, and data handling (by role and date)
- Background check vendor confirmations and an anonymized sample of results (redacted PII)
- Offboarding / deprovisioning playbook and a sample deprovisioning log showing when accounts were disabled
- Any attestation templates employees sign on hire / exit (DocuSign links okay)

I realize some items contain sensitive data — redacted PDFs or aggregated CSVs are fine. If a subset will take longer, please let me know what you can get by Dec 24 and estimate delivery for the remainder.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Green
Vendor Risk Manager, ACME Corp
alyssa.green@acme-corp.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel verification items for SOC 2 window

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the list and the timeline. We're able to compile most of this by Dec 24 but will need a couple of clarifications to avoid unnecessary redaction work:

1) For the background check samples, do you need the vendor confirmation letter (signed statement) in addition to anonymized results?
2) For the training matrix, would a role-level export plus a per-employee completion roster be sufficient? We can provide both: a role summary (CSV) and a redacted roster (PDF).

Plan: Marcus will pull training and deprovision logs; I'll coordinate HR for background vendor confirmations and the attestation DocuSign links. We will provide an initial bundle (role summary + redacted samples + playbook v2) by Dec 24 and follow with raw logs/redacted CSVs by Dec 28.

Putting the team on copy: Marcus, can you confirm ETA for the training export and deprovision sample? Karthik — can you flag any compliance constraints we should follow for sharing redacted background data?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, alyssa.green@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-12-19T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel verification items for SOC 2 window

Vanessa — I pulled the exports this morning:

- training-roster-2026Q4.pdf (attached): per-employee rows with completion dates; PII (email) redacted where requested
- deprovision-logs-sample.csv (attached): account disable events for 2026-06 through 2026-11 with timestamp and account id (ids are internal hashes, no cleartext usernames)

Notes: Our background-check vendor (ClearVerity) provides a vendor confirmation letter and per-employee screening codes; we can provide the vendor letter plus an aggregated summary (pass/consider/watch) in background-check-summary-redacted.pdf. HR requires that we remove DOB and SSN from any shared sample; full results are HR-only.

ETA: I can get the aggregated background confirmation and attach the offboarding playbook by end of day Dec 20.

-Marcus
From: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@acme-corp.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, soc2@secureassess.com
Date: 2026-12-19T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel verification items for SOC 2 window

Thanks Marcus — helpful. A couple quick follow-ups:

- The vendor confirmation letter is perfect; for our audit notes we also like to capture the vendor contract snapshot (one-page statement of scope) if that's available.
- For the deprovision log: can you include a short mapping doc that explains the internal hash -> account type (service account, user, admin) mapping? If you can't map to exact usernames that's fine; we just need to understand the classes of accounts impacted by deprovisioning.
- For the attestation, a DocuSign link or screenshot of the last 6 months of signed attestations works.

If you can drop the initial bundle in a shared Drive folder and send the link, that would speed things up.

Best,
Alyssa
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Green <alyssa.green@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, soc2@secureassess.com
Date: 2026-12-20T16:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel verification items for SOC 2 window

Alyssa — attaching the initial bundle per your request. Files included: training-roster-2026Q4.pdf (role summary + redacted roster), background-check-summary-redacted.pdf (vendor confirmation + aggregated pass/consider/watch counts), offboarding-playbook-v2.docx (internal playbook), deprovision-logs-sample.csv (sample events), and a small mapping note.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_redwood_personnel
DocuSign room: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/12345-personnel-attestation (contains the last 6 months of attestation receipts; access granted to your acme account)

Karthik — per your review, we've redacted sensitive fields and added a short attestation paragraph describing retention/HR access controls. If ACME needs signed attestations bundled into a single PDF, we can pull that as a follow-up.

Next steps: Alyssa, confirm receipt and if ACME's team wants copies of the vendor contract snapshot (ClearVerity scope), we'll provide that under an NDA request (HR legal prefers a controlled release).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference
attachments: [training-roster-2026Q4.pdf, background-check-summary-redacted.pdf, offboarding-playbook-v2.docx, deprovision-logs-sample.csv, personnel-attestation-docusign-link.txt]
